## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include a small pattern/input
example for matching changes and identify any API or ownership changes.

## Validation

List the commands actually run, compiler versions and targets. Distinguish
compilation from target execution; explain any checks not run.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the required checks. Behavior
changes need focused regressions; packaging changes need the archive-consumer
check from [RELEASING.md](../RELEASING.md).
